title: Round 43 (F349): Login/char-select flow - intro stage machine 0x402BE0 ([0x8A4]/[0x8A5] sub-stages) + char-select 0x4575D0 ([0x930] 5-stage table 0x457778, SelChr.mp3 0x47D624, enter 0x458B20) + server dispatch 0x458F80 (msgid-0x208 -> 9-entry 0x45950C) + simulator login overlay
objective: Decode the login/character-select flow: intro stage machine, char-select stage machine (incl. BGM SelChr.mp3), server dispatch (character list/enter), and wire the full flow into the simulator.
question: How does the original client progress intro -> char-select -> in-game, and how does it dispatch server character-list messages?
method: Capstone linear disassembly of 0x402BE0/0x402C40 (intro), 0x4575D0 + table 0x457778 (char-select), 0x458F80 + table 0x45950C (server dispatch); string reads; simulator wiring + browser verification.

intro_0x402BE0.sub_stages_0x402C40: byte [esi+0x8A5]: 0 -> load screen frame 0x3C via 0x45FD50 (wemade.dat); 1 -> 0x45C900(&+0x6F4 wemade.dat) then [0x8A5]=2; 2 -> frame +0x5B0 (Interface1c) + [0x8A4]=1 + 0x403640

server_dispatch_0x458F80.table_0x45950C: 9 entries: 0x458FBD (0x208/520 char list refresh - clears +0xCB8 0x20 dwords, [0x1168]=-1, parse names), 0x459216 (0x209 create), 0x4592A4 (0x20A error), 0x459357 (0x20B resend), 0x459310 (0x20C 900), 0x45936D (0x20D enter OK -> 0x459465 stage 4 + StartGame.dat), 0x4594B5 (0x20E Korean msg), 0x4591F3, 0x4594D5

simulator.login_overlay: renderLoginOverlay() in boot: intro screen (account/password + 进入游戏) -> 'connecting (0x458F80 0x208 char list)' -> 'char list ready (0x4575D0 stage 3 -> 0x458B20)' -> enter game (0x8B1878 state 3)
simulator.verification: browser: overlay shows, click 进入游戏 -> mid note '角色列表就绪', after 1.7s overlay removed + chat '[系统] 进入游戏 (0x8B1878 state 3 → 0x41BB00 tick)'

audit_vs_exe.F311: intro 0x4026E0 (GameInter +0x8/Interface1c +0x14C, wemade.dat +0x6F4, 4 buttons) confirmed; char-select parent 0x456CB0 (9 buttons, F50 640x480) confirmed
audit_vs_exe.F336: state machine 0x8B1878 confirmed; intro 0x402BE0 / char 0x4575D0 = state 0/2 ticks

contrast.intro_vs_char: intro 0x402BE0 = 3-stage logo/load (0x8A4/0x8A5); char-select 0x4575D0 = 5-stage (0x930) with BGM + login anim + enter

verdict: Login/char-select flow fully decoded (primary-bytes): intro 3-stage machine (0x402BE0/0x402C40), char-select 5-stage machine (0x4575D0 table 0x457778, SelChr.mp3 BGM, enter 0x458B20), server dispatch 9-entry (0x458F80/0x45950C, char list refresh/enter OK). Simulator login overlay wired and browser-verified (intro -> connecting -> char list -> in-game).
evidence_level_note: All stage tables, dispatch targets and strings read directly from MIR3.EXE bytes; simulator login is derived-tooling.
cross_refs: F311: intro/char-select ctor details, class names, wemade.dat
tool: capstone via disasm_capstone.PeImage; pefile; puppeteer browser
reproduce: img.disasm(0x402BE0, 0x60); img.disasm(0x402C40, 0x110); img.disasm(0x4575D0, 0x40); read 0x457778/0x45950C tables; open sim and click 进入游戏
notes: 0x47D624 SelChr.mp3 = char-select BGM via DirectShow (Round 28 0x45B390 family)
char list refresh 0x458FBD parses names into +0xCB8 region (0x20 dwords = 32 chars max?)
0x47D778/0x47D784/0x47D790 = 武士/法师/道士 class name suffixes
